text:
Marta: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A. Sales and CS asked for a tiny, shareable timeline for model pinning + rollout UI, Console Optimize suggestions/export/apply, and streaming+function-calls GA. Can leadership confirm windows?

Eli: High-level snapshot to unblock teams: model pinning + rollout UI -> internal canary early Aug, org-limited beta mid-Aug, GA contingent on canary (aiming late Aug). Console Optimize suggestions -> console preview in Sept; suggestion export (CSV/JSON) + opt-in apply API -> late Sept/early Oct. Streaming + function-calls -> feature-flag GA in ~4-6 weeks. Will publish an RFC with gating criteria.

Jun: Infra caveat: rollout UI depends on the traffic-slice scheduler (ENG-3344). There's a reproducible p99 spike when shards rebalance; pairing with runtime tomorrow AM. Repro command I used: ```kubectl -n infra logs deploy/traffic-scheduler | grep rebalance``` . If that blocks, public beta slips ~1-2 weeks.

Katherine: For external comms, please use month windows not hard dates. Suggested pasteable customer blurb: "Planned windows: rollout UI beta in August (GA after canary), Optimize console preview in September with export and opt-in apply to follow, and streaming+function-calls reaching feature-flag GA in ~4-6 weeks. Exact GA dates will be shared after canary and QA."

Marta: Can someone add the rollback/guardrails summary we can give CS?

Eli: Rollback short version: rollout UI is behind per-org feature flags, staged ramp with rate limits, and an auto-fallback to the previous routing model if p50 latency or error rate exceeds configured thresholds for 5m. RFC will include PromQLs and dashboard links.

Jun: Note on Optimize: v1 export formats are CSV and JSON only. One-click apply is opt-in per-org and will run a short eval (1-3 hours) against a representative set before changing production routing.

Katherine: Internal one-liner for reps: "Snapshot: rollout UI (canary -> org beta -> GA after canary), Optimize console preview in Sept with export and opt-in apply following, streaming+function-calls feature-flag GA in ~4-6 weeks. Precise dates pending infra and QA gating."

Eli: I'll post the RFC tonight and tag docs, CS, and product. Will include the exact monitoring queries and the rollback playbook.
